notes.title: Announcement: Freak Show
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LouzEdUdJjc;full][/previewyoutube]
Freak Show! (Coming soon)
It has been many years, but we are happy to announce that we have a new party game on the way. So buckle up for we have taken the best parts of 8Bit Fiesta and added even better stuff and combined it all into one crazy party game.

Freak Show: Party Royale
An insane and brutal local multiplayer party game for 1-6 players. Compete in a large collection of deadly mini games until there is only one Freak Show Champion left standing!

Please wishlist now!
The game will be released once we have gathered enough wishlists, so please consider to wishlist the game to keep track of the release announcement and to get the latest news and information about any upcoming beta tests. Thank you!

notes.title: NOW FREE TO PLAY!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9840368/9bf95501e722873ded089662341733708ba697b4.png

Free 2 Play | F2P
8Bit Fiesta is now a free to play game on Steam! This means that anyone will be able to play it for free and if they like it they can buy game packs to unlock more games to play.

What about premium users?
Everyone who bought the game before the transition to F2P is a premium user and will automatically recieve all game packs for free so your game is fully unlocked which the f2p version is not. So in short, premium version = all mini games and f2p version = not all mini games.

This way both free and premium users will have paid the same price for the fully unlocked game in the end.

Why F2P
We want to show as many as possible how fun you can have with the game and by going F2P we give people the chance to try it out risk free. There are so many games on Steam and it is hard to get noticed so hopefully this will help to shed some light on the game so we can continue to make awesome party games.


Thank you for reading and party on! :skaal:

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9840368/032e4bb399c6242f7b2cbdeb53cbe11b223cfc0c.gif

Full release out now!
The time has come to leave early access and go into a full release. Thank you all for the ideas and feedback that has helped me make this game.

And worry not! More free updates are coming regularly with fixes, new mini games and features even though we're not in early access anymore :)

Pricing Information
After leaving "EA" the base price of the game will slightly increase and to make the transition as smooth as possible the full release will launch with a discount so all of you who have followed the game but doesn't own it yet have plenty of time to purchase it at the early access price. I don't want anyone to feel tricked by the price change so I think this is the best solution.

What happens now?
The game will continue to be updated with improvements and addons. So if you have feedback and ideas then feel free to post it on the steam forum so I know what you want :D And once again, thank you all who have been here from the start. Without your feedback this game wouldn't have been possible to make for a single developer like me. So thank you!

The save system has been changed in this version so to load your old save files you'll have to run the "savetool.exe" in the installation folder and your old saves will be available again when you start the game.

And if you have any problems with the new version then you can play the previous version which you'll find in the installation folder under "Previous Version".


Change Log

    New mini game | Stay Green
    Shuttle Up Redesigned
Trigger Box Tweaked
    Flappy Tap Rounds Added
Drink Intensity Option Added
Physball Improved Movement
Major Performance Tweaks
+Many Minor Bug FIxes


Hope you'll enjoy this update and please remember to report any bugs or issues on the discussion board :)

Thank you in advance!

RESTART THE STEAM CLIENT TO GET THE UPDATE

notes.title: Latest News
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/100012196/Demos/Images/news.png
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/100012196/Demos/Images/easter.gif

Happy Easter everyone!

I just wanted to post a little message about the upcoming updates so you don't think I have disappeared into thin air or something :D

I've been hard at work and have recieved plenty of feedback from the community and I have tried to implement as much of your ideas as I can into the game.

So a lot of work has been made to polish the existing game and implementing new content and features at the same time.

This means that instead of many small updates there will be fewer but bigger ones.

Small patches have been released in silence during this time but big updates will always come with an announcement.

So here is a little list of what is coming in future updates:


    New tournament settings
    New Trap Run Levels
    New Battle Arena Levels
    World 3 singleplayer
    New characters
    Online leaderboards
    New games to compete in
    More achievements
    Bug Fixes
    New soundtrack
    Unlock new characters in multiplayer
    Plus other tweaks and improvements.


And as always, if you have any feedback or want to post your ideas. Then please leave your thoughts on the discussion board and I will see what I can do ːsteamhappyː

Stay tuned...

notes.title: Design Competition Winner
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/100012196/Demos/Images/fh.png

THANK YOU ALL

Thank you all for the great entries. We have looked at them all and it was a hard decision to pick only one winner. The decision is based on:


Art style
Creativity
Suitable for the game
Number of used pixels


So many good designs and I would like to say that many of these were good enough for the game. But we can only have one winner.

And the winner is....


















Somewhere at the bottom of this page


















Drumroll!















PotatoNightmare's design: Adam Streaker!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/100012196/Demos/Images/adam_idle.gif

Motivation: The design might be simple but the cartoonish look and fun design is perfect for 8Bit Fiesta and will be a playable character in the game soon if PotatoNightmare approves :) A steam key is coming your way.

..............................................................................................................

It was a very tight race and I would like to thank everyone again for participating. Which one was your favorite? Tell us in the comments below.

notes.title: WEEKEND COMPETITION
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/100012196/Demos/Images/comp.png

How to enter the competition

Download this  TEMPLATE	

Open it with your software of choice and make your design. Try to not go too far outside the silhouette and keep the white background.

Save the file as a png and post it on twitter under #8bitFiestaComp and include the name of your character. If you don't have twitter then post a link in the comments :)

Winner will be picked on Wednesday October 7th

Don't forget to share this in your groups so we get to see a lot of designs :) Have a great weekend!
